title: ManuSpectrum - Storage and backups
description: How full the disks are, what each data directory weighs, how fast it grows, when it would fill, whether backups are fresh, what Docker and Prometheus keep on disk.

panels.title: / used
panels.description: Used share of the filesystem mounted on /.

panels.title: / free
panels.description: Free space on / (what the system can still write).

panels.title: / size
panels.description: Total size of the filesystem mounted on /.

panels.title: / time until full
panels.description: Days until / is full if the last 7 days of trend continue. Empty when free space is not shrinking.

panels.title: /data used
panels.description: Used share of the filesystem mounted on /data.

panels.title: /data free
panels.description: Free space on /data (what the system can still write).

panels.title: /data size
panels.description: Total size of the filesystem mounted on /data.

panels.title: /data time until full
panels.description: Days until /data is full if the last 7 days of trend continue. Empty when free space is not shrinking.

panels.title: Filesystem use over 30 days
panels.description: Used share of / and /data.

panels.title: Free space over 30 days
panels.description: Free bytes on / and /data. A line going down is a disk filling.

panels.title: Size now
panels.description: Size of each data directory: uploaded media, the backup repository, database dumps, nginx logs.

panels.title: Directory size over 30 days
panels.description: History of the four directory sizes.

panels.title: Growth over 30 days
panels.description: Change of each directory over the last 30 days (extrapolated to 30 days when less history exists).

panels.title: Directory measure age
panels.description: Time since every directory was last measured completely. The nightly timer keeps it under a day.

panels.title: Directory measure failed
panels.description: 1 when the last run could not measure a directory (timeout).

panels.title: Database size now
panels.description: Size of the application database as PostgreSQL reports it.

panels.title: Database size over 30 days
panels.description: History of the database size.

panels.title: Database growth over 30 days
panels.description: Change of the database size over the last 30 days (extrapolated when less history exists).

panels.title: Backup repository size
panels.description: Size of the restic repository on /data.

panels.title: Backup repository over 30 days
panels.description: History of the repository size.

panels.title: Repository growth over 30 days
panels.description: Change of the repository over the last 30 days (extrapolated when less history exists).

panels.title: Last good backup
panels.description: Time since the last backup that completed. A nightly timer keeps it under a day.

panels.title: Last backup run
panels.description: Outcome of the most recent backup attempt.

panels.title: Last good restore test
panels.description: Time since the weekly restore test last passed.

panels.title: Last restore test run
panels.description: Outcome of the most recent restore test.

panels.title: Database dump size
panels.description: Size of the database dump of each good backup.

panels.title: Backup and restore test duration
panels.description: Seconds the last good backup and restore test took.

panels.title: Docker disk use (measured hourly by docker system df)
Docker use now
panels.description: What Docker keeps on disk: images, build cache, container layers and volumes. Sizes are decimal with four significant digits.

panels.title: Docker use over 30 days
panels.description: History of Docker disk use by kind.

panels.title: Volumes now
panels.description: Size of each Compose volume (ms_pg_data, ms_es_data, ms_prometheus_data, ms_cantaloupe_cache, ms_redis_broker and the others), largest first.

panels.title: Volume size over 30 days
panels.description: History of each Compose volume.

panels.title: Docker growth over 30 days
panels.description: Change of each kind of Docker disk use over the last 30 days (extrapolated when less history exists).

panels.title: Volume growth over 30 days
panels.description: Change of each Compose volume over the last 30 days (extrapolated when less history exists).

panels.title: Prometheus data size
panels.description: Disk used by the Prometheus time series database (blocks plus write-ahead log).

panels.title: Prometheus data vs 8 GB cap
panels.description: Share of the retention size cap (--storage.tsdb.retention.size, 8 GB) already used: past it Prometheus deletes the oldest blocks before the 30 days are over.

panels.title: Prometheus data over 30 days
panels.description: Prometheus database size against its cap.
